text_block_list.text: I… I've lost… This can't be!

text_block_list.text: The possibilities this world holds are far more abundant than my own!

text_block_list.text: Haha, things are really starting to get interesting now. I can't wait to come up with new ways to seize victory from here on out!

text_block_list.text: Thank you for your concern, but there's no need to fret!

text_block_list.text: I'll never lose hope, no matter what! And I'll never, ever give up!

text_block_list.text: I promise that in my next race, I'll become the brightest pearl of all!
